settings.memory: 2048px tiles and one horizontal stitching band; reused exact validated PNG bytes for this batch

limits: Authored static layouts, not live gameplay screenshots or current hosting assertions.
No constructors, spawned objects, lighting, smoothing, animation, randomization or lower-level view compositing executed.
Editor helpers and source-declared positive invisibility are omitted with logged source evidence. Unknown types or unavailable states remain diagnostics and are excluded.
The renderer is task-local; this directory alone does not reproduce the pipeline. Source/fingerprint/dependency hashes identify the inputs.
Existing Wasteland page illustrates Wasteland II. Original Wasteland source has unresolved appearances and is outside this clean eight-map batch.
